title: Enemy Captain Behavior Tree

nodes.name: Combat Director
nodes.readability: The enemy announces every mode switch with animation and bark.

nodes.name: Has Line Of Sight
nodes.counterplay: Break sightline, slide to cover, or smoke the lane.

nodes.name: Telegraphed Burst
nodes.action: fire three-shot burst with muzzle flare tell
nodes.counterplay: Dodge after flare or interrupt during recovery.

nodes.name: Flank Cover
nodes.action: move to nearest side cover if suppressed
nodes.readability: Voice bark and visible route line in debug overlay.

nodes.name: Hear Distraction
nodes.counterplay: Throw decoy to pull patrol away from the objective route.

nodes.name: Investigate Noise
nodes.action: move to sound origin with flashlight cone and alert bark
nodes.readability: Suspicion meter, cone color, and subtitle bark show the state change.

nodes.name: Coordinate Squad
nodes.action: assign one flanker and one suppressor when allies are alive
nodes.counterplay: Stagger the captain to break squad coordination.

nodes.name: Boss Phase Gate
nodes.condition: armor below 45% or objective core exposed
nodes.readability: Armor plate break, camera pulse, and VO line announce phase change.

nodes.name: Enraged Phase Pattern
nodes.action: swap to slower heavy attacks with longer telegraphs and bigger recovery
nodes.counterplay: Bait heavy swing, punish recovery, or trigger steam vent stagger.

nodes.name: Preserve Survival Pressure
nodes.action: avoid stacking support call, hazard, and low-resource pressure in the same 10 seconds
nodes.readability: Debug intensity meter shows why the director delayed a spike.

nodes.name: Faction Retreat
nodes.action: retreat and mark territory if morale collapses or rival faction event starts
nodes.counterplay: Cut off the retreat path for bonus reputation.

nodes.name: Call Support
nodes.action: summon one support unit after 18 seconds if player turtles
nodes.counterplay: Push captain below armor threshold to cancel call.

transitions.trigger: player remains in same cover cluster > 18s

readableTells: Armor plate break announces the phase gate before new attacks appear.
Squad command bark names the next tactic before enemies reposition.
counterplayRules: Every support call has a cancel window.
Every stealth alert has a recovery state before full combat.
Every enraged-phase attack has longer anticipation than the phase-one equivalent.
dynamicDifficultyRules: Delay support calls when player health is critical and no cover is nearby.
Reduce flank aggression if the player failed the same encounter twice.
Never hide phase transitions by increasing damage without a new tell.
difficultyNotes: Raise challenge by shortening recovery and improving flank choice, not by hiding telegraphs.
accessibilityNotes: Pair visual tells with audio cues, subtitle barks, and controller vibration timing.
